title: Senior Amazon Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Amazon Account Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping LA SIESTA find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Amazon Account Manager .


You'll own Amazon growth end-to-end, building systems and shaping AI tools for a global brand.


Compensation:

USD 2.2K - 3.2K/month


Location:

Remote (specific timezone) - GMT-08:00 to GMT-02:00


Mission of LA SIESTA:

\"Improving Lives… One Hammock At a Time\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in Pay-per-click (PPC), Keyword research, Content optimization, Amazon search engine optimization (Amazon SEO), and Amazon Seller Central.
  • You are proficient in Data analysis, Account management.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

The Role:

  • You will own LA SIESTA's Amazon presence end-to-end: catalog, Buy Box, advertising, SEO, and conversion.
  • You will work independently as a remote team member, coordinate directly with our Miami office, and loop in our German HQ on product and brand matters.
  • You are not just running campaigns; you are building a system, and you will have the tools and the mandate to improve how we operate on Amazon over time.


Responsibilities:

Catalog & Listings:

  • Own and maintain the LA SIESTA catalog on Amazon: parent/child structures, variations, attributes, and content.
  • Create and update listings independently, including A+ content and storefront.
  • Design catalog assets and visuals yourself; you produce what you need, no agency dependency.
  • Ensure listing health and resolve suppressed/blocked ASINs proactively.


Buy Box & Pricing:

  • Monitor Buy Box ownership and pricing competitiveness across all active ASINs.
  • Identify Buy Box loss patterns and act fast: pricing, fulfillment, or seller issues.
  • Coordinate with the team on repricing strategy where needed.


Advertising (PPC):

  • Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
  • Use buying intent signals and search term data to drive campaign structure and bidding decisions.
  • Optimize based on ACOS/ROAS targets: not just spend, but profit contribution.
  • Run systematic keyword harvesting and negative keyword management.


SEO & Conversion:

  • Research and apply high-intent keywords to titles, bullets, backend, and A+ content.
  • Run conversion audits: identify and fix friction in listing content, images, or positioning.
  • Analyze traffic versus conversion gaps to prioritize action.


Analytics & Reporting:

  • Pull and interpret Seller Central reports, Brand Analytics, and Search Term data.
  • Track KPIs (sessions, CVR, ACOS, revenue, BSR) and report clearly to the US team.
  • Connect data dots across catalog, ads, and SEO to find leverage points.


Tool Development & AI Collaboration:

  • Work with our proprietary Claude-based Amazon plugin: use it daily, push its limits.
  • Identify gaps in the plugin's skills and commands, and contribute to improving them.
  • Use Claude, Cowork, and/or Claude Code to automate repetitive tasks and build better workflows.


What You Bring:

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (non-FBA experience required).
  • Hands-on catalog setup experience: not just edits, but builds from scratch.
  • Proven Buy Box management and competitive analysis.
  • Strong PPC skills: campaign architecture, bid strategy, and data-driven optimization.
  • Amazon SEO expertise: keyword research, placement strategy, and content optimization.
  • Conversion optimization mindset: you read listings like a buyer.
  • Fluent in English: written and verbal, professional level.
  • Self-directed: you manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't wait to be asked.


Strongly Preferred:

  • Technical background: you are comfortable with data, APIs, or automation.
  • Design skills: you can produce your own listing images and catalog visuals (Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Claude AI, Cowork, or Claude Code.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience working across international teams (US/Europe).


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote position with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Direct ownership of a meaningful, high-visibility channel.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tooling: and the opportunity to shape it.
  • Collaboration with a passionate, international team.
  • A brand with real products, real customers, and real growth potential.


Job benefits:

  • PTO.
  • Remote work.


Your potential leader:

  • Carl Maximilian Grisar - CEO of Relaxation at LA SIESTA
  • Elmar Braun

title: Senior Amazon Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Amazon Account Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping LA SIESTA find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Amazon Account Manager .


You'll own Amazon growth end-to-end, building systems and shaping AI tools for a global brand.


Compensation:

USD 2.2K - 3.2K/month


Location:

Remote (specific timezone) - GMT-08:00 to GMT-02:00


Mission of LA SIESTA:

\"Improving Lives… One Hammock At a Time\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in Pay-per-click (PPC), Keyword research, Content optimization, Amazon search engine optimization (Amazon SEO), and Amazon Seller Central.
  • You are proficient in Data analysis, Account management.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

The Role:

  • You will own LA SIESTA's Amazon presence end-to-end: catalog, Buy Box, advertising, SEO, and conversion.
  • You will work independently as a remote team member, coordinate directly with our Miami office, and loop in our German HQ on product and brand matters.
  • You are not just running campaigns; you are building a system, and you will have the tools and the mandate to improve how we operate on Amazon over time.


Responsibilities:

Catalog & Listings:

  • Own and maintain the LA SIESTA catalog on Amazon: parent/child structures, variations, attributes, and content.
  • Create and update listings independently, including A+ content and storefront.
  • Design catalog assets and visuals yourself; you produce what you need, no agency dependency.
  • Ensure listing health and resolve suppressed/blocked ASINs proactively.


Buy Box & Pricing:

  • Monitor Buy Box ownership and pricing competitiveness across all active ASINs.
  • Identify Buy Box loss patterns and act fast: pricing, fulfillment, or seller issues.
  • Coordinate with the team on repricing strategy where needed.


Advertising (PPC):

  • Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
  • Use buying intent signals and search term data to drive campaign structure and bidding decisions.
  • Optimize based on ACOS/ROAS targets: not just spend, but profit contribution.
  • Run systematic keyword harvesting and negative keyword management.


SEO & Conversion:

  • Research and apply high-intent keywords to titles, bullets, backend, and A+ content.
  • Run conversion audits: identify and fix friction in listing content, images, or positioning.
  • Analyze traffic versus conversion gaps to prioritize action.


Analytics & Reporting:

  • Pull and interpret Seller Central reports, Brand Analytics, and Search Term data.
  • Track KPIs (sessions, CVR, ACOS, revenue, BSR) and report clearly to the US team.
  • Connect data dots across catalog, ads, and SEO to find leverage points.


Tool Development & AI Collaboration:

  • Work with our proprietary Claude-based Amazon plugin: use it daily, push its limits.
  • Identify gaps in the plugin's skills and commands, and contribute to improving them.
  • Use Claude, Cowork, and/or Claude Code to automate repetitive tasks and build better workflows.


What You Bring:

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (non-FBA experience required).
  • Hands-on catalog setup experience: not just edits, but builds from scratch.
  • Proven Buy Box management and competitive analysis.
  • Strong PPC skills: campaign architecture, bid strategy, and data-driven optimization.
  • Amazon SEO expertise: keyword research, placement strategy, and content optimization.
  • Conversion optimization mindset: you read listings like a buyer.
  • Fluent in English: written and verbal, professional level.
  • Self-directed: you manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't wait to be asked.


Strongly Preferred:

  • Technical background: you are comfortable with data, APIs, or automation.
  • Design skills: you can produce your own listing images and catalog visuals (Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Claude AI, Cowork, or Claude Code.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience working across international teams (US/Europe).


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote position with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Direct ownership of a meaningful, high-visibility channel.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tooling: and the opportunity to shape it.
  • Collaboration with a passionate, international team.
  • A brand with real products, real customers, and real growth potential.


Job benefits:

  • PTO.
  • Remote work.


Your potential leader:

  • Carl Maximilian Grisar - CEO of Relaxation at LA SIESTA
  • Elmar Braun

Contract | Remote

Nice to have


  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows

About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

We are seeking a hands-on Jira Administrator and GitHub Enterprise Administrator to support backend platform administration, integrations, workflow automation, and an Azure DevOps to GitHub Enterprise migration.   • Support Azure DevOps to GitHub Enterprise migration activities including repository migration, pipeline review, permissions mapping, and process alignment.
  • Configure and maintain GitHub workflows, GitHub Actions, automation tasks, agents, runners, and integrations.
  • Support GitHub Enterprise integrations with Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD tools, security platforms, identity providers, and cloud services.
  • Assist teams with repository governance, access control, pull request standards, branch strategy, and release workflows.
  • Troubleshoot GitHub Enterprise issues related to workflows, runners, permissions, integrations, and automation.
  • Help define best practices for GitHub Enterprise usage across engineering and DevOps teams.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience administering Jira in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience administering GitHub Enterprise.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira workflows, automation, permissions, schemes, dashboards, and integrations.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, runners, branch protections, repository permissions, and enterprise governance.
  • Experience supporting or leading Azure DevOps to GitHub Enterprise migrations.
  • Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, source control, release workflows, and software delivery processes.
  • Experience integrating Jira and GitHub with enterprise tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot backend platform issues across Jira, GitHub, identity, permissions, and automation layers.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work with engineering, security, operations, and leadership teams.

title: Designer / Editor de Vidéo Motion Design
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer / Editor de Vidéo Motion Design em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A ZYPHER GLOBAL

A Zypher Global é uma infraestrutura de pagamentos para a América Latina. Conectamos PIX, USDT/cripto e múltiplas moedas (BRL, MXN e outras) em uma única API, ajudando empresas a receber, enviar e escalar pagamentos de forma rápida, segura e moderna. Estamos crescendo forte na região e investindo pesado em aquisição via anúncios para levar nossa solução a cada vez mais negócios.


O CARGO

Procuramos um Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer disruptivo para nos ajudar a escalar em anúncios. Você vai produzir criativos de alta performance para mídia paga e peças de motion design institucionais que traduzam um produto técnico (API, PIX, USDT, cripto) em mensagens claras e que convertem. Mais do que \"deixar bonito\", queremos alguém que entenda o que faz um anúncio parar o scroll, prender a atenção nos primeiros segundos e gerar conversão.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Criar e editar vídeos de anúncios (ads) para Meta, YouTube, TikTok e outras plataformas, com foco direto em conversão.
  • Desenvolver roteiros e estruturas de vídeo orientados a performance (hooks fortes, ângulos de copy, CTAs e variações para teste A/B).
  • Transformar conceitos técnicos de pagamentos (API, PIX, USDT, cripto, multimoedas) em narrativas simples e visuais.
  • Produzir motion graphics e animações institucionais que reforcem a marca da Zypher.
  • Editar a partir do briefing: organizar material bruto, montar narrativa, aplicar ritmo, trilha, efeitos e tratamento de cor.
  • Criar múltiplas variações de criativos para escalar campanhas e acelerar testes.
  • Acompanhar referências de ads, especialmente do universo fintech/cripto, e formatos que estão performando.
  • Colaborar com o time de tráfego/marketing para interpretar dados e melhorar os criativos com base em resultados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeo e motion design (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Domínio de Adobe Premiere e After Effects (ou ferramentas equivalentes).
  • Experiência com criativos para anúncios / mídia paga e entendimento de vídeos orientados a conversão.
  • Boa noção de storytelling, ritmo e do que prende a atenção nos primeiros segundos.
  • Capacidade de simplificar temas técnicos (pagamentos, API, cripto) em mensagens visuais claras.
  • Organização, boa comunicação e autonomia para trabalho remoto.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência direta com criativos que escalaram campanhas (resultados comprovados).
  • Vivência com produtos de fintech, pagamentos, cripto ou SaaS/API.
  • Conhecimento de copywriting para ads e estruturas de VSL.
  • Vivência com testes A/B de criativos e análise de métricas (CTR, CPA, ROAS).
  • Repertório disruptivo: referências fora do óbvio e vontade de inovar em formatos.

Esta é uma vaga remota, em regime de contrato/por projeto, com interação constante com o time de marketing e produto. Se você respira ads, motion e performance — e curte a ideia de vender tecnologia de pagamentos na LATAM — queremos ver o seu trabalho. Envie seu portfólio.

title: Designer / Editor de Vidéo Motion Design
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer / Editor de Vidéo Motion Design em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A ZYPHER GLOBAL

A Zypher Global é uma infraestrutura de pagamentos para a América Latina. Conectamos PIX, USDT/cripto e múltiplas moedas (BRL, MXN e outras) em uma única API, ajudando empresas a receber, enviar e escalar pagamentos de forma rápida, segura e moderna. Estamos crescendo forte na região e investindo pesado em aquisição via anúncios para levar nossa solução a cada vez mais negócios.


O CARGO

Procuramos um Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer disruptivo para nos ajudar a escalar em anúncios. Você vai produzir criativos de alta performance para mídia paga e peças de motion design institucionais que traduzam um produto técnico (API, PIX, USDT, cripto) em mensagens claras e que convertem. Mais do que \"deixar bonito\", queremos alguém que entenda o que faz um anúncio parar o scroll, prender a atenção nos primeiros segundos e gerar conversão.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Criar e editar vídeos de anúncios (ads) para Meta, YouTube, TikTok e outras plataformas, com foco direto em conversão.
  • Desenvolver roteiros e estruturas de vídeo orientados a performance (hooks fortes, ângulos de copy, CTAs e variações para teste A/B).
  • Transformar conceitos técnicos de pagamentos (API, PIX, USDT, cripto, multimoedas) em narrativas simples e visuais.
  • Produzir motion graphics e animações institucionais que reforcem a marca da Zypher.
  • Editar a partir do briefing: organizar material bruto, montar narrativa, aplicar ritmo, trilha, efeitos e tratamento de cor.
  • Criar múltiplas variações de criativos para escalar campanhas e acelerar testes.
  • Acompanhar referências de ads, especialmente do universo fintech/cripto, e formatos que estão performando.
  • Colaborar com o time de tráfego/marketing para interpretar dados e melhorar os criativos com base em resultados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeo e motion design (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Domínio de Adobe Premiere e After Effects (ou ferramentas equivalentes).
  • Experiência com criativos para anúncios / mídia paga e entendimento de vídeos orientados a conversão.
  • Boa noção de storytelling, ritmo e do que prende a atenção nos primeiros segundos.
  • Capacidade de simplificar temas técnicos (pagamentos, API, cripto) em mensagens visuais claras.
  • Organização, boa comunicação e autonomia para trabalho remoto.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência direta com criativos que escalaram campanhas (resultados comprovados).
  • Vivência com produtos de fintech, pagamentos, cripto ou SaaS/API.
  • Conhecimento de copywriting para ads e estruturas de VSL.
  • Vivência com testes A/B de criativos e análise de métricas (CTR, CPA, ROAS).
  • Repertório disruptivo: referências fora do óbvio e vontade de inovar em formatos.

Esta é uma vaga remota, em regime de contrato/por projeto, com interação constante com o time de marketing e produto. Se você respira ads, motion e performance — e curte a ideia de vender tecnologia de pagamentos na LATAM — queremos ver o seu trabalho. Envie seu portfólio.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems.
  • Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks.
  • Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

description:

Company Description

Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.


The Role

This is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.


You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.


In practice, that means:

  • Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact
  • Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months
  • Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them
  • Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting
  • Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate
  • Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act
  • Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case


You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.


What this role requires

  • Fluent English: written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;

(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)

  • Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit
  • Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time
  • Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)
  • Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company


What will make you stand out

  • Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar
  • Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)
  • Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
  • Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality
  • Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies


What you'll be measured on

Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.


Compensation

Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

description:

  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields.
  • Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation.
  • Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis.
  • Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation.
  • Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes.

title: IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist


Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele.


Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day.


This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do.


Main Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution.
  • Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay.
  • Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity.
  • Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues.
  • Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations.
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed.
  • Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives.
  • Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding.
  • Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms.
  • Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start.
  • Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings.
  • Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms.
  • Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting.


Skills & Competencies

-IP Knowledge & Process Orientation

  • Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines.
  • Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks.
  • A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.


-Client Focus & Communication

title: Designer / Editor de Vidéo Motion Design
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer / Editor de Vidéo Motion Design em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A ZYPHER GLOBAL

A Zypher Global é uma infraestrutura de pagamentos para a América Latina. Conectamos PIX, USDT/cripto e múltiplas moedas (BRL, MXN e outras) em uma única API, ajudando empresas a receber, enviar e escalar pagamentos de forma rápida, segura e moderna. Estamos crescendo forte na região e investindo pesado em aquisição via anúncios para levar nossa solução a cada vez mais negócios.


O CARGO

Procuramos um Editor de Vídeo / Motion Designer disruptivo para nos ajudar a escalar em anúncios. Você vai produzir criativos de alta performance para mídia paga e peças de motion design institucionais que traduzam um produto técnico (API, PIX, USDT, cripto) em mensagens claras e que convertem. Mais do que \"deixar bonito\", queremos alguém que entenda o que faz um anúncio parar o scroll, prender a atenção nos primeiros segundos e gerar conversão.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Criar e editar vídeos de anúncios (ads) para Meta, YouTube, TikTok e outras plataformas, com foco direto em conversão.
  • Desenvolver roteiros e estruturas de vídeo orientados a performance (hooks fortes, ângulos de copy, CTAs e variações para teste A/B).
  • Transformar conceitos técnicos de pagamentos (API, PIX, USDT, cripto, multimoedas) em narrativas simples e visuais.
  • Produzir motion graphics e animações institucionais que reforcem a marca da Zypher.
  • Editar a partir do briefing: organizar material bruto, montar narrativa, aplicar ritmo, trilha, efeitos e tratamento de cor.
  • Criar múltiplas variações de criativos para escalar campanhas e acelerar testes.
  • Acompanhar referências de ads, especialmente do universo fintech/cripto, e formatos que estão performando.
  • Colaborar com o time de tráfego/marketing para interpretar dados e melhorar os criativos com base em resultados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeo e motion design (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Domínio de Adobe Premiere e After Effects (ou ferramentas equivalentes).
  • Experiência com criativos para anúncios / mídia paga e entendimento de vídeos orientados a conversão.
  • Boa noção de storytelling, ritmo e do que prende a atenção nos primeiros segundos.
  • Capacidade de simplificar temas técnicos (pagamentos, API, cripto) em mensagens visuais claras.
  • Organização, boa comunicação e autonomia para trabalho remoto.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência direta com criativos que escalaram campanhas (resultados comprovados).
  • Vivência com produtos de fintech, pagamentos, cripto ou SaaS/API.
  • Conhecimento de copywriting para ads e estruturas de VSL.
  • Vivência com testes A/B de criativos e análise de métricas (CTR, CPA, ROAS).
  • Repertório disruptivo: referências fora do óbvio e vontade de inovar em formatos.

Esta é uma vaga remota, em regime de contrato/por projeto, com interação constante com o time de marketing e produto. Se você respira ads, motion e performance — e curte a ideia de vender tecnologia de pagamentos na LATAM — queremos ver o seu trabalho. Envie seu portfólio.

Job Description

  • Full Time
  • Remote
  • 2.000 USD


About Us:


We are a growth financing marketplace for small business owners, with a mission to increase access to entrepreneurship. By connecting businesses to growth capital and offering world-class financial management services, we empower entrepreneurs to take control of their financials and achieve sustainable economic success.


The Role:


We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to execute comprehensive accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting and exceptional client service across multiple business entities. This role focuses on hands-on accounting execution with complex client portfolios in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. The right candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable managing complex client relationships independently while leveraging cutting-edge technology and AI tools.


Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate books for multiple clients, including daily reconciliations and month-end close procedures
  • Manage comprehensive AP/AR processes and ensure timely, organized financial record maintenance
  • Prepare and review monthly financial statements, ensuring accuracy and client-ready presentation
  • Execute month-end and year-end close processes, coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Review reconciliations and financial statements for accuracy, identifying and resolving complex accounting issues
  • Identify discrepancies and resolve accounting issues proactively, maintaining data integrity across all client accounts.
  • Handle and analyze complex accounting multi-entity cases and provide adjustments proposals.
  • Leverage AI tools and automation to optimize accounting workflows and improve efficiency
  • Adapt quickly to new technology platforms, integrations, and AI-powered accounting solutions
  • Support process improvements and system optimization initiatives
  • Provide clear financial insights for client decision-making, acting as a trusted financial advisor
  • Communicate insights clearly to help clients understand their numbers with clarity and confidence
  • Collaborate with Tax and CX teams to ensure seamless client experience and accurate financial data flow


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting/Finance or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of U.S. GAAP accounting experience, IFRS Reporting, including multi-entity and complex business structures
  • Tech-savvy with strong aptitude for learning new software, AI tools, and automation platforms
  • Experience with modern accounting tech stack beyond QuickBooks (APIs, integrations, data analysis tools)
  • Comfortable working in an AI-driven, technology-first environment with rapid tool adoption
  • Client-facing experience with strong communication and presentation skills
  • Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and willingness to master emerging fintech solutions
  • Detail-oriented, hands on, accountable, and deadline-driven with daily bookkeeping activities, driving strategic financial analysis and strong sense of prioritization to meet deadlines.
  • Experienced with process improvement and system implementation
  • Strong analytical skill, confidently review financial data and turn it into clear, actionable insights.
  • Experienced in identifying discrepancies, spotting trends, and ensuring the accuracy of financial records.
  • Understanding of accounting-tax interdependencies and multi-state compliance requirements
  • Excited about leveraging technology to scale accounting operations and improve client outcomes
  • Advanced or native English proficiency


Details

  • Full-time position (Remote – Colombia, Brasil, Guatemala)

Exclusivity required — no simultaneous employment during agreed working hours.

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets.
  • Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation.
  • Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain.
  • Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies.
  • Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving.
  • Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation.
  • Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

title: AI Web Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Web Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)


Contract | Remote


We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for


  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Experience supporting website migration or rebuild projects using AI-assisted workflows, including translating existing websites into cleaner, scalable frontend structures while maintaining design quality, SEO, performance, and maintainability.
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have


  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like


  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Remote Quality Analyst-Multimodality
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Quality Analyst-Multimodality em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing


Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview


In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .

  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .

  • You have 3+ years of experience in Pay-per-click (PPC), Keyword research, Content optimization, Amazon search engine optimization (Amazon SEO), and Amazon Seller Central.
  • You are proficient in Data analysis, Account management.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

The Role:

  • You will own LA SIESTA's Amazon presence end-to-end: catalog, Buy Box, advertising, SEO, and conversion.
  • You will work independently as a remote team member, coordinate directly with our Miami office, and loop in our German HQ on product and brand matters.
  • You are not just running campaigns; you are building a system, and you will have the tools and the mandate to improve how we operate on Amazon over time.


Responsibilities:

Catalog & Listings:

  • Own and maintain the LA SIESTA catalog on Amazon: parent/child structures, variations, attributes, and content.
  • Create and update listings independently, including A+ content and storefront.
  • Design catalog assets and visuals yourself; you produce what you need, no agency dependency.
  • Ensure listing health and resolve suppressed/blocked ASINs proactively.


Buy Box & Pricing:

  • Monitor Buy Box ownership and pricing competitiveness across all active ASINs.
  • Identify Buy Box loss patterns and act fast: pricing, fulfillment, or seller issues.
  • Coordinate with the team on repricing strategy where needed.


Advertising (PPC):

  • Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
  • Use buying intent signals and search term data to drive campaign structure and bidding decisions.
  • Optimize based on ACOS/ROAS targets: not just spend, but profit contribution.
  • Run systematic keyword harvesting and negative keyword management.


SEO & Conversion:

  • Research and apply high-intent keywords to titles, bullets, backend, and A+ content.
  • Run conversion audits: identify and fix friction in listing content, images, or positioning.
  • Analyze traffic versus conversion gaps to prioritize action.


Analytics & Reporting:

  • Pull and interpret Seller Central reports, Brand Analytics, and Search Term data.
  • Track KPIs (sessions, CVR, ACOS, revenue, BSR) and report clearly to the US team.
  • Connect data dots across catalog, ads, and SEO to find leverage points.


Tool Development & AI Collaboration:

  • Work with our proprietary Claude-based Amazon plugin: use it daily, push its limits.
  • Identify gaps in the plugin's skills and commands, and contribute to improving them.
  • Use Claude, Cowork, and/or Claude Code to automate repetitive tasks and build better workflows.


What You Bring:

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (non-FBA experience required).
  • Hands-on catalog setup experience: not just edits, but builds from scratch.
  • Proven Buy Box management and competitive analysis.
  • Strong PPC skills: campaign architecture, bid strategy, and data-driven optimization.
  • Amazon SEO expertise: keyword research, placement strategy, and content optimization.
  • Conversion optimization mindset: you read listings like a buyer.
  • Fluent in English: written and verbal, professional level.
  • Self-directed: you manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't wait to be asked.


Strongly Preferred:

  • Technical background: you are comfortable with data, APIs, or automation.
  • Design skills: you can produce your own listing images and catalog visuals (Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Claude AI, Cowork, or Claude Code.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience working across international teams (US/Europe).


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote position with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Direct ownership of a meaningful, high-visibility channel.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tooling: and the opportunity to shape it.
  • Collaboration with a passionate, international team.
  • A brand with real products, real customers, and real growth potential.


Job benefits:

  • PTO.
  • Remote work.


Your potential leader:

  • Carl Maximilian Grisar - CEO of Relaxation at LA SIESTA
  • Elmar Braun

Excellent communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively within teams and across engineering and security organizations.

A passion for efficiency, high availability, and delivering top-tier technical solutions.

title: Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

Tax Preparer  — Full-time Remote

- Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

- Excellent written and verbal English communication

- Self-motivated and comfortable working as a fully integrated remote team member

- Not form-filling—we need someone who understands tax law deeply and can optimize client outcomes

- Not hourly task work—we're hiring a trusted tax professional, not a contractor

  • Experience integrating Jira and GitHub with enterprise tools.

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
  • Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
  • Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
  • Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
  • Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
  • People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.


Também é legal se você tiver:


  • Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

title: Remote Quality Analyst-Multimodality
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Quality Analyst-Multimodality em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing


Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview


In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

title: Remote Physics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
